output.explanation: The warehouse has no stock or inventory data, so the current stock level of the ergonomic office chair can't be determined. marts.dim_products holds only product attributes (SKU, name, category, list price, unit cost, active flag), and the order tables record quantities ordered, not quantities on hand. Units sold can't stand in for stock, because there are no opening balances or goods receipts. For current stock, check your inventory or warehouse management system. I can instead report units of the chair sold in completed orders, or its price and active status.
